newsitem.title: ITALY: Generali H1 1996 pretax profit falls.
newsitem.headline: Generali H1 1996 pretax profit falls.

text.p: Life premium income 2,598.4 vs up 17.5 percent
Non-life premium income 2,963.4 vs up 1.2 percent

NOTE - Italian insurer Generali said that in the first half of 1996 its ordinary operating result had improved by 120 billion lire, but extraordinary items worsened by 140 billion lire reflecting foreign exchange losses of 204 billion lire which were due to the appreciation of the lira.
However, the company said in a statement that it expected its 1996 results would be better than in 1995.
Life premiums in Italy 1,078 vs up 8.5 percnet
Non-life premiums in Italy 1,526.8 vs up 6.6 percent
Generali said that its investments at June 30 1996 reached 40,255.4 billion lire, up some 1,435.3 billion over the course of the half year.
